digest.component_or_area: plan review prompt caching and prefix reuse across passes
propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier system prompts must begin with a byte-identical shared prefix containing the full plan text to enable provider-side cache reuse and chunk-level prefix efficiency
A single-source preamble constant (SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE) must replace separate definitions in passes.py and be extended with an exhaustiveness directive for incremental-depth BLOCK loops
The shared plan prefix, measured via _prefix_tokens(), must meet or exceed CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS (4096 tokens) for the Pass-1 finder warm gate to determine batching

Verifier templates must remove the volatile marker and trailing {{plan}} block, placing {{shared_prefix}} at the head to inline the plan into the system prompt while keeping the per-run finding listing in the user message
The workflow gate (plan-review.yaml) and verification schema must emit and consume shared_prefix rather than plan, with RunnerAgentStep's generic variable-merge mechanism unchanged
